searchDocs.title: How do I use this?​
searchDocs.content: If you're wanting to use this example structure for your own Roblox project, start by downloading the template from the releases page.  Read the rest of the documentation here to learn more about how to use all of the features, and how to set up your project fully.

searchDocs.title: Comprehensive workflow​
searchDocs.content: This is not a comprehensive guide on how you set up your project, instead just manging much of the boilerplate for you. If you want, you can read the Oxomo Coding Conventions for information like that: https://miagobble.github.io/Oxomo-Coding-Conventions/

searchDocs.title: Editing code​
searchDocs.content: Code is edited locally, using a tool like Visual Studio Code. Use Rojo to sync your code to your local build.rbxl place file.  Create build.rbxl, just run the following command in your project's terminal:  lune run lune/build   danger DO NOT EDIT/SYNC CODE IN game.rbxl! This can lead to massive, difficult-to-fix merge conflicts.

searchDocs.title: Editing assets or services​
searchDocs.content: Edit assets/services directly in game.rbxl. Save these changes by saving the file normally.

searchDocs.title: Editing remotes​
searchDocs.content: Edit remote events/functions in src/Shared/Remotes.model.json, using Rojo model.json format. Alternatively, create a Remotes.luau file where the remotes folder would go, which as a dictionary of remote signals/events created by a networking library.  info game.rbxl is a binary place file. rbx-merge is set up so Git can still diff and merge it. Follow the rbx-merge steps in the setup docs once per clone.

searchDocs.title: Publishing​
searchDocs.content: To publish your game, simply push or merge to the main branch on Git! A GitHub action will build and publish the game for you.

searchDocs.title: Building docs​
searchDocs.content: Documentation is also built when pushing or merging to the main branch. A GitHub action handles this!  As a note, the first time you push, you should set up GitHub pages. Go to your GitHub repository, settings, and then Pages. Select the newly created gh-pages branch as the branch, and then save.  danger You cannot use GitHub pages on a private repository without the proper subscription! In this case, you can view docs locally by running moonwave dev --code src in your folder's terminal.

searchDocs.title: Using Pesde packages​
searchDocs.content: To add packages to your game, you can use packages from the pesde registry or the Wally registry.  Add a pesde package:  pesde add scope/package   Add a Wally package:  pesde add wally#scope/package   Then install dependencies:  pesde install   Packages are installed into roblox_packages/ and synced to ReplicatedStorage.SharedModules.Packages via Rojo. Typechecking for Wally dependencies is handled automatically by pesde's sourcemap_generator script during install.

searchDocs.title: Recommended settings​
searchDocs.content: If you're using Luau Language Server on Visual Studio Code, it's recommended you use the following settings:  luau-lsp.fflags.enableNewSolver: true # Use the new type solver luau-lsp.completion.autocompleteEnd: true # Write "end" automatically for things like if statements luau-lsp.completion.fillCallArguments: false # This can be pretty annoying luau-lsp.completion.showAnonymousAutofilledFunction: false # Also very annoying when it happens   Also ensure that the plugin is regenerating the Rojo sourcemap when your tree updates! This is handy for many of the other tools.

searchDocs.title: Updating docs​
searchDocs.content: You should see a docs folder in your repository, where you can write docs in markdown format. See more info here: https://eryn.io/moonwave/docs/Docs

searchDocs.title: API​
searchDocs.content: API documentation is automatically generated by moonwave. To see it locally, run moonwave dev --code src.

searchDocs.title: Configuring moonwave​
searchDocs.content: To configure moonwave, you will need to edit moonwave.toml. See more here: https://eryn.io/moonwave/docs/Configuration

searchDocs.title: First-time stuff​
searchDocs.content: You'll need to do a few things one time only, if you have not already. You only need to do these once for them to work for all of your projects!

searchDocs.title: Installing Rokit (once per machine)​
searchDocs.content: You will need Rokit to use Rojo, Pesde, rbx-merge, and Lune.  To download Rokit on macOS or Linux, run this in your terminal:  curl -sSf https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rojo-rbx/rokit/main/scripts/install.sh | bash   To download Rokit on Windows, run this in PowerShell:  Invoke-RestMethod https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rojo-rbx/rokit/main/scripts/install.ps1 | Invoke-Expression

searchDocs.title: Initializing each project​
searchDocs.content: First, you'll need to publish your repository on GitHub. To do so, do the following in order:  Create GitHub repositoryClone repository locally (such as through GitHub desktop)Copy-paste everything from the template into the clone directory

searchDocs.title: Installing tools (once per clone)​
searchDocs.content: To install the tools included with the project, run rokit install in the folder's terminal.

searchDocs.title: Installing packages (once per clone)​
searchDocs.content: To install project packages, run pesde install in the folder's terminal.  warning You will need to reinstall packages every time you change pesde.toml!

searchDocs.title: Generating initial sourcemap (once per clone)​
searchDocs.content: To generate the initial sourcemap, run this in your terminal:  rojo sourcemap default.project.json --output sourcemap.json

searchDocs.title: Setting up rbx-merge​
searchDocs.content: rbx-merge is used to clean up diffs in version control over game.rbxl.  Once per repository, run the following:  rbx-merge install --write-gitattributes git add .gitattributes git commit -m "Mark Roblox files binary"   And once per clone, run the following:  rbx-merge install rbx-merge doctor

searchDocs.title: Customizing your stuff (once per repository)​
searchDocs.content: It's recommended you do the following to customize your repository further:  Remove default licenseChange README to your own stuffEdit moonwave.toml (https://eryn.io/moonwave/docs/Configuration)Remove these docs

searchDocs.title: Setting up GitHub secrets (once per repository)​
searchDocs.content: You will need to set up secrets for automated publishing.

searchDocs.title: On Roblox​
searchDocs.content: First, go to the Roblox Creator page, click All tools, and click API Keys.  Create an API Key, naming it something like "automated publishing".  Scroll down to Permissions, and add the following permissions:  universe-places (write)  You may choose to restrict by experience and/or IP addresses. Make sure the key does not expire.  On the security warning popup, click the "I understand the security risks" checkbox, and then save & generate key. Save this key by clickikng "copy key to clipboard".  warning Make sure to save your key! It will go away once you leave the page.

searchDocs.title: On GitHub​
searchDocs.content: Now that you have your Roblox API key, go to your project, then settings, then secrets and variables > actions.  You are going to create three new repository secrets, each created by clicking "new repository secret".  For the first secret, use these details:  Name: ROBLOX_API_KEYSecret: Your API key  For the second secret, use these details:  Name: UNIVERSE_IDSecret: Your universe ID (also known as "game" or "experience" id, this it not your place ID)  Lastly, you'll need a secret with these details:  Name: PLACE_IDSecret: Your main place ID (not the universe ID)  Finally, take a look at .github/workflows/publish.yml in your repository. Change the branch that triggers this from none to main.
